39466-reading-the-weather.title: Reading The Weather
39466-reading-the-weather.creator: T. Morris Longstreth
39466-reading-the-weather.description: A book by T. Morris Longstreth. Science is certainly coming into her own nowadays,--and into everybody else's. Every activity of man and most of Nature's have felt her quickening hand. Her eye is upon the rest. Drinking is going out because the drinker is inefficient. The fly is going out because he carries germs. And for everything that goes out something else comes in that makes people healthier and more comfortable, and, perhaps, wiser.

67703-the-master-spirit.title: Spirit
67703-the-master-spirit.creator: Sir William Magnay
67703-the-master-spirit.description: A book by Sir William Magnay. discharged its crowd into the illuminated night. Out they came hurrying, for the hour was late: the sitting had been animated and prolonged, and even professional, to say nothing of casual, politicians are nowadays too busy in wasting the nation’s time not to set a high value on their own.

arxiv-2107-01652.title: A quantum bound on the 1 / f 1/f noise in semiconductors with a conical energy-momentum dispersion
arxiv-2107-01652.creator: Kirill A. Kazakov
arxiv-2107-01652.description: Abstract The quantum indeterminacy caused by non-commutativity of observables at different times sets a lower bound on the voltage noise power spectrum in any conducting material. This bound is calculated explicitly in the case of semiconductors with a conical energy-momentum dispersion of charge carriers. It possesses all characteristic properties of 1 / f 1/f noise.

arxiv-2109-02769.title: Two-to-two processes at an electron-muon collider.
arxiv-2109-02769.creator: Antonio O. Bouzas and F. Larios
arxiv-2109-02769.description: Abstract Based on a recent proposal to build an electron-muon collider, we study two-to-two production processes e − ​ μ + → f ​ f ¯ e^{-}\mu^{+}\rightarrow f\bar{f} , γ ​ γ \gamma\gamma that originate from dimension 6 and 8 operators.

arxiv-2204-12995.title: Magnetochiral Properties of Spin Waves Existing in Nanotubes with Axial and Circumferential Magnetization
arxiv-2204-12995.creator: M. C. Giordano, M. Hamdi, A. Mucchietto, D. Grundler
arxiv-2204-12995.description: Abstract We report experimental studies of spin-wave excitations in individual 22 nm thick Ni 80 Fe 20 nanotubes with diameters of about 150 nm by means of Brillouin light-scattering (BLS) spectroscopy. Irradiated by microwaves we resolve sets of discrete resonances in the center of nanotubes ranging from 2.5 to 12.5 GHz.

arxiv-2210-09071.title: Attention Attention Everywhere: Monocular Depth Prediction with Skip Attention
arxiv-2210-09071.creator: Ashutosh Agarwal, Chetan Arora
arxiv-2210-09071.description: Abstract Monocular Depth Estimation (MDE) aims to predict pixel-wise depth given a single RGB image. For both, the convolutional as well as the recent attention-based models, encoder-decoder-based architectures have been found to be useful due to the simultaneous requirement of global context and pixel-level resolution.

arxiv-2212-14743.title: Risk-Sensitive Policy with Distributional Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2212-14743.creator: Thibaut Théate, Damien Ernst
arxiv-2212-14743.description: Abstract Classical reinforcement learning (RL) techniques are generally concerned with the design of decision-making policies driven by the maximisation of the expected outcome. Nevertheless, this approach does not take into consideration the potential risk associated with the actions taken, which may be critical in certain applications.

arxiv-2404-13385.title: Anisotropic Rabi model with two-photon relaxation
arxiv-2404-13385.creator: Hui Li, Jia-Kai Shi, Li-Bao Fan, Zi-Min Li, Chuan-Cun Shu
arxiv-2404-13385.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hui Li, Jia-Kai Shi, Li-Bao Fan, Zi-Min Li, Chuan-Cun Shu. The interplay of three light-matter interaction processes - rotating and counter-rotating interactions and two-photon relaxation of the light field - is a topic of interest in quantum optics and quantum information processing. In this work, we theoretically investigate the three light-matter interaction processes using the anisotropic Rabi model, which accounts for different strengths of rotating and counter-rotating interactions and the unique occurrence of photon escape exclusively in pairs.

arxiv-2410-06124.title: Learning AND-OR Templates for Professional Photograph Parsing and Guidance
arxiv-2410-06124.creator: Xin Jin, Liaoruxing Zhang, Chenyu Fan, Wenbo Yuan
arxiv-2410-06124.description: Abstract Since the development of photography art, many so-called ”templates” have been formed, namely visual styles summarized from a series of themed and stylized photography works. In this paper, we propose to analysize and and summarize these ’templates’ in photography by learning composite templates of photography images.

arxiv-2412-00612.title: A Szegő Limit Theorem for Radially-Compressed Toeplitz Operators
arxiv-2412-00612.creator: Trevor Camper

From this, we derive a formula for the density of the eigenvalues of compressions of Toeplitz operators. Examples for the Bergman and Segal-Bargmann-Fock space are also presented. 1. arxiv-2508-03608.title: CloudBreaker: Breaking the Cloud Covers of Sentinel-2 Images using Multi-Stage Trained Conditional Flow Matching on Sentinel-1
arxiv-2508-03608.creator: Saleh Sakib Ahmed, Sara Nowreen, M. Sohel Rahman
arxiv-2508-03608.description: Abstract Cloud cover and nighttime conditions remain significant limitations in satellite-based remote sensing, often restricting the availability and usability of multi-spectral imagery. In contrast, Sentinel-1 radar images are unaffected by cloud cover and can provide consistent data regardless of weather or lighting conditions.

arxiv-2509-17837.title: Fast and Accurate Decoder for the XZZX code Using Simulated Annealing
arxiv-2509-17837.creator: Tatsuya Sakashita
arxiv-2509-17837.description: Abstract The XZZX code is a variant of the surface code designed to address biased noise in realistic quantum devices. For the XZZX code, we propose a decoder based on simulated annealing (SA). Our SA decoder can be readily and efficiently parallelized, by virtue of its simple MCMC-based algorithm.

arxiv-2512-19736.creator: Gongli Xi, Ye Tian, Mengyu Yang, Zhenyu Zhao, Yuchao Zhang, Xiangyang Gong, Xirong Que, Wendong Wang
arxiv-2512-19736.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Gongli Xi, Ye Tian, Mengyu Yang, Zhenyu Zhao, Yuchao Zhang, Xiangyang Gong, Xirong Que, Wendong Wang. The structure of topology underpins much of the research on performance and robustness, yet available topology data are typically scarce, necessitating the generation of synthetic graphs with desired properties for testing or release. Prior diffusion-based approaches either embed conditions into the diffusion model, requiring retraining for each attribute and hindering real-time applicability, or use classifier-based guidance post-training, which does not account for topology scale and practical constraints.

pmc-10612227.title: Individuals of a group-living shorebird show smaller home range overlap when food availability is low
pmc-10612227.creator: He-Bo Peng, Chi-Yeung Choi, Zhijun Ma, Allert I Bijleveld, David S Melville, Theunis Piersma
pmc-10612227.description: BackgroundGroup living animals, such as shorebirds foraging on intertidal mudflats, may use social information about where to find hidden food items. However, flocking also increases intraspecific competition for resources, which may be exacerbated by food scarcity. Therefore, although aggregation may bring benefits, it may also increase the intensity of intraspecific competition.

pmc-11443095.title: Irregularity of visual motion perception and negative symptoms in schizophrenia
pmc-11443095.creator: Yi Fan, Yunhai Tao, Jue Wang, Yuan Gao, Wei Wei, Chanying Zheng, Xiaotong Zhang, Xue Mei Song, Georg Northoff
pmc-11443095.description: Schizophrenia (SZ) is a severe psychiatric disorder characterized by perceptual, emotional, and behavioral abnormalities, with cognitive impairment being a prominent feature of the disorder. Recent studies demonstrate irregularity in SZ with increased variability on the neural level. Is there also irregularity on the psychophysics level like in visual perception?

pmc-11652091.title: The open accordion: a novel application of endoscopic sleeve gastroplasty for the treatment of refractory gastroparesis
pmc-11652091.creator: Alexander J. Podboy, Tala Mahmoud, Calvin X. Geng, Andrew Y. Wang
pmc-11652091.description: Video Introduction Gastroparesis is a chronic debilitating disease of the stomach associated with profound decreases in patient quality of life.1 Despite a rising prevalence, therapeutic options remain markedly limited. Although gastric peroral endoscopic myotomy (G-POEM) has emerged as a novel therapy for gastroparesis, success rates are variable and therapeutic options for patients that fail G-POEM are limited.

pmc-12573434.title: Validation of the CLIF-SIG score in patients with HBV-related acutely decompensated cirrhosis
pmc-12573434.creator: Jiyang Chen, Xianbin Xu, Sisi Yang, Xia Yu, Ferran Aguilar, Joan Claria, Jonel Trebicka, Juan José Lozano, Julia Sidorova, Paolo Angeli, Alberto Queiroz Farias, Richard Moreau, Wenyi Gu, Zelu Meng, Ying Nie, Yining Zhang, Xiaohan Qian, Yu Shi, Yida Yang
pmc-12573434.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ed the Chronic Liver Failure-Systemic Inflammation Gene score (CLIF-SIG) score to predict short-term outcomes in patients with acutely decompensated cirrhosis (AD). The study demonstrated the robustness of CLIF-SIG across multiple international cohorts, predominantly consisting of alcohol-related cirrhosis.

pmc-12618843.title: Posterior Approach to Humeral Head for Allograft Reconstruction of Hill-Sachs Lesions
pmc-12618843.creator: Olivia O’Reilly, Katherine Kutzer, Julia E. Ralph, Jonathan Dickens, Brian C. Lau
pmc-12618843.description: Background:Anterior glenohumeral instability is common in athletes and is often associated with an impaction fracture of the posterolateral humeral head, known as a Hill-Sachs lesion. As humeral bone loss increases, these lesions become more likely to engage anteriorly and require surgical intervention.

pmc-12662785.title: Synergistic Effect of Enzyme‐Assisted Fermentation on Phytochemical Content, Volatile Profile, and Antioxidant, Antidiabetic, and ACE Inhibitory Properties of Sea Buckthorn‐Based Cereal Beverages
pmc-12662785.creator: Afusat Yinka Aregbe, Shamas Murtaza, Ebenezer Ola Falade, Md Hafizur Rahman, Yongkun Ma
pmc-12662785.description: Today, plant‐based beverages are increasingly being recognized for their health‐promoting properties. Here, we investigate how the innovative use of enzyme‐assisted fermentation enhances the phytochemical content, bioactivity, and aroma profile of sea buckthorn‐based cereal beverages (SBCB). Enzyme‐assisted fermentation significantly increased phytochemical content compared to the untreated sample. Specifically, F3% (fermented, 3% enzyme‐treated SBCB) boosted total phenolic and flavonol contents by 124.

pmc-12784805.title: A Phase II Study of Toripalimab in Combination with Gemcitabine and 5-Fluorouracil as First-Line Therapy for Advanced or Metastatic Biliary Tract Carcinoma
pmc-12784805.creator: Fangyong Lei, Wenjing Deng, Ying Zhou, Lilan Fang, Xiuxin Lin, Lingyu Qin, Chunming Li, Jian Rao, Gengsheng Yu
pmc-12784805.description: Simple SummaryBiliary tract carcinoma (BTC) is a rare, aggressive cancer arising from biliary epithelial cells, often diagnosed at advanced stages with a median survival of less than one year. Prior investigations have explored the efficacy of programmed cell death protein 1 (PD-1) inhibitors and gemcitabine-based chemotherapy regimens in advanced BTC.

pmc-13036974.title: Age of acquisition of disease-causal human papillomavirus infection to high-grade cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN2+) in England
pmc-13036974.creator: Alhaji Cherif, Kayla Engelbrecht, Olga Ovcinnikova-Hutchings, Dionysios Ntais, Xuedan You
pmc-13036974.description: BackgroundThe human papillomavirus (HPV) is the primary causative risk factor for developing cervical intraepithelial neoplasia (CIN), which can progress to cervical cancer in women. The age at which women in England acquire a causal HPV infection that progresses into CIN and subsequently cervical cancer is not well understood.

pmc-13216585.title: Genome-wide identification and expression analysis of HMAs gene family in tobacco under abiotic stress
pmc-13216585.creator: Baorui Huang, Fugui Wang, Gang Luo, Qiuliang Yuan, Jin Huang, Zhenhua Wang, Xinfa Wang, Shiying Nong, Yachun Lu, Junlin Li, Fenglin Huang, Qi Zhao, Chunlai Wu, Huanhuan Wang, Zongcan Yang
pmc-13216585.description: The heavy metal ATPase (HMA) family, classified as P1B-ATPases, plays a pivotal role in maintaining plant metal homeostasis by coupling ATP hydrolysis to the active transport of metal ions across biological membranes. However, comprehensive characterization of the HMA family in tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum) remains insufficient.

pmc-13265653.title: Celecoxib adjunct to antidepressants for major depressive disorder: Systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13265653.creator: Manit Srisurapanont, Chawisa Suradom, Sirijit Suttajit
pmc-13265653.description: This systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized, placebo-controlled trials evaluated the efficacy, acceptability, and tolerability of celecoxib as an adjunct to antidepressants for major depressive disorder (MDD). PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Google Scholar, and ClinicalTrials.gov were searched from inception to April 11, 2026. The primary outcome was change in depressive symptom severity.

pmc-13387427.title: Kawashima procedure without fenestration in a 5-month-old infant with functional single ventricle and interrupted inferior vena cava: a case report
pmc-13387427.creator: Khanh Van T Le, Tin D Le
pmc-13387427.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Kawashima procedure is a variant of the bidirectional Glenn used in patients with interrupted inferior vena cava (IVC) and azygos continuation, though optimal timing and the role of fenestration remain debated. We report a 5-month-old boy with functional single ventricle physiology, transposition of the great arteries, pulmonary valve atresia with ventricular septal defect, interrupted IVC with azygos continuation, and bilateral superior vena cavae, who presented with cyanosis and failure to thrive.

pmc-13397967.title: The role of age and antibodies in central regional lymph node metastases of papillary thyroid carcinoma combined with hashimoto’s thyroiditis
pmc-13397967.creator: Chengcheng Duan, Ping Yu, Xinran Wei, Jingyue Zhong, Xianji Wu, Siqi Xiao, Guang Zhang
pmc-13397967.description: BackgroundThe coexistence of Hashimoto thyroiditis (HT) and papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC) is increasing year by year, and the role of age, thyroglobulin antibodies (TgAb), and thyroid peroxidase antibodies (TPOAb) in central neck lymph node metastasis (CLNM) in PTC patients with HT is still controversial.

pmc-13462953.title: Perioperative pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma care in 2025: who needs neoadjuvant?—who needs radiation?
pmc-13462953.creator: Runan Sheng, Qiong Wu, Kejia Lan
pmc-13462953.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Despite advances in multimodal therapy, pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) remains a highly fatal tumor. For surgically resectable and borderline-resectable PDAC (BR-PDAC), the optimal integration of neoadjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy has yet to be established. Recent randomized studies (e.g., ESPAC-5F, NORPACT-1, Alliance A021501, and PREOPANC) and updated guidelines [of the National Comprehensive Cancer Network (NCCN), European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO), and Japanese Society of Hepato‑Biliary‑Pancreatic Surgery (JASPAC)] now identify which patients are likely to benefit from treatment before surgery.
